question: Identify the synonym of 'Fickle':
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Unpredictable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Fickle"** means someone or something that changes frequently or unpredictably, especially in terms of loyalty or preferences. (चंचल, अस्थिर)
 
 
• **Example:** The weather in this region is fickle; it can be sunny one moment and raining the next.
 
 
• **"Unpredictable"** refers to something that cannot be anticipated or foreseen, aligning perfectly with the meaning of "fickle". (अप्रत्याशित)
 
 
• **Example:** His unpredictable behavior makes it hard to rely on him during critical situations.
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the synonym of **'Fickle' **is **'Unpredictable'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Unpredictable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Constant** (स्थिर): Something that remains the same over time and does not change.
 
 
• **Example:** She has been a constant source of support for me during tough times.
 
 
 
• **Reliable** (विश्वसनीय): Something or someone that can be depended upon and trusted.
 
 
• **Example:** This car is reliable and has never broken down in the last five years.
 
 
 
• **Stable** (स्थिर): Something that is firmly established and unlikely to change or fluctuate.
 
 
• **Example:** The political situation in the country has become stable after years of turmoil.
